body: May human-design lesson dito: maliit ang effort ng form, pero ang cost ng delay puwedeng real money. Hindi fair na i-reduce ito sa ‘responsible people apply on time.’ For an older person, official-looking mail, eligibility language, scam warnings, at deadlines can create hesitation rather than action. Kaya magandang practical response ang hindi lang sabihing ‘apply’—kung may pensioner sa family, offer to sit beside them while they verify and file. Dignity-preserving help means supporting the decision, not taking over it.

claims.text: Administrative complexity and fraud caution can plausibly create hesitation for some recipients even when filing effort is low.
claims.basis: Reflection inference from the article's documented claim process, deadline consequences, and anti-fraud warning; not asserted as measured behavior among recipients.
